# M11-S3: `logos test` finds the test functions of a _test.lgo file that holds
# loGo/s-only syntax (`T?`, `??`), which go/parser rejects.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos test -v ./ok
stdout '--- PASS: TestOptional'
stdout '--- PASS: TestGeneric'
stdout '--- PASS: FuzzSeed'
stdout '^ok'
! stdout 'no tests to run'

# A wrong test signature in a _test.lgo file still reports the position.
! logos test ./badsig
stderr 'wrong signature for TestBad'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/t

go 1.27

-- ok/p.lgo --
package ok

type Box struct {
	N int32?
}

-- ok/p_test.lgo --
package ok

import "testing"

type helper func(x int) int

var handler = func(t *testing.T) {}

func (b Box) unused() {}

func identity[T any](x T) T { return x }

func TestOptional(t *testing.T) {
	var b Box
	if (b.N ?? 7) != 7 {
		t.Fatal("none must fall back")
	}
	b.N = 3
	if (b.N ?? 7) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("some must win")
	}
}

func TestGeneric(t *testing.T) {
	if identity(5) != 5 {
		t.Fatal("identity")
	}
}

func FuzzSeed(f *testing.F) {
	f.Add(1)
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, x int) {})
}

-- badsig/p.lgo --
package badsig

type Box struct {
	N int32?
}

-- badsig/p_test.lgo --
package badsig

import "testing"

func TestBad(t *testing.B) {
	var b Box
	_ = b.N ?? 1
}
